weeks.label: Week 1
weeks.title: Learn the movements
weeks.goal: Three short full-body sessions using gentle versions of each exercise. The aim is confidence, not soreness.
weeks.notes: Use slow, controlled movement. Stop if you feel chest pain, dizziness, unusual breathlessness or sharp joint pain. This is intentionally conservative.

tasks.title: 5-minute warm-up
tasks.description: March on the spot, shoulder circles, hip circles and gentle bodyweight hinges.
tasks.detail: Wake the joints up before asking them to work.

tasks.title: 2 rounds: squat, push, hinge, core
tasks.description: Do 8 chair squats, 6 incline press-ups, 8 glute bridges and a 15-second forearm plank.
tasks.detail: Rest as needed. Use a table/worktop for incline press-ups.

tasks.title: 3-minute cool-down
tasks.description: Easy breathing plus gentle chest, hip flexor and hamstring stretches.
tasks.detail: Leave feeling better than when you started.

tasks.title: 10-minute mobility reset
tasks.description: Cat-cow, child’s pose, thoracic rotations and ankle rocks on the mat.
tasks.detail: This should feel restorative, not like a workout.

tasks.title: 5-minute warm-up
tasks.description: March on the spot, arm swings, hip circles and gentle lunges to a comfortable depth.

tasks.title: 2 rounds: legs, shoulders, back, core
tasks.description: Do 6 reverse lunges per side, 8 wall slides, 10 prone Y-T raises and 6 dead bugs per side.
tasks.detail: Hold a wall or chair for balance during lunges.

tasks.title: 3-minute cool-down
tasks.description: Stretch calves, quads, chest and upper back gently.

tasks.title: 10-minute mobility reset
tasks.description: Repeat Tuesday’s mobility or choose the tightest areas: hips, back, shoulders and ankles.

tasks.title: 5-minute warm-up
tasks.description: Repeat Monday’s warm-up.

tasks.title: 2 rounds: squat, push, hinge, core
tasks.description: Do 8 chair squats, 6 incline press-ups, 8 glute bridges and a 15-second forearm plank.
tasks.detail: Try to make the movement smoother than Monday.

tasks.title: 3-minute cool-down
tasks.description: Easy breathing plus gentle chest, hip flexor and hamstring stretches.

tasks.title: Optional 8-minute core practice
tasks.description: Do 2 gentle rounds of 6 dead bugs per side and 15-second side planks from knees per side.
tasks.detail: Skip this if you feel tired or sore.

tasks.title: Proper rest
tasks.description: No strength work today. A walk is fine if you want one.
tasks.detail: Recovery is part of the plan.

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.title: Build consistency
weeks.goal: Keep three full-body sessions and add a little volume without making the sessions long.
weeks.notes: Aim for an effort of about 6–7 out of 10. You should finish knowing you worked, but not feeling wrecked.

tasks.title: 5-minute warm-up
tasks.description: March on the spot, shoulder circles, hip circles and gentle bodyweight hinges.

tasks.title: 3 rounds: squat, push, hinge, core
tasks.description: Do 8 chair squats, 7 incline press-ups, 10 glute bridges and a 20-second forearm plank.
tasks.detail: Add the third round only if form stays tidy.

tasks.title: 3-minute cool-down
tasks.description: Easy breathing plus gentle chest, hip flexor and hamstring stretches.

tasks.title: 10-minute mobility and balance
tasks.description: Do cat-cow, thoracic rotations, ankle rocks and 3 x 20-second single-leg stands per side.
tasks.detail: Use a wall or worktop for balance.

tasks.title: 5-minute warm-up
tasks.description: March on the spot, arm swings, hip circles and gentle lunges.

tasks.title: 3 rounds: legs, shoulders, back, core
tasks.description: Do 7 reverse lunges per side, 10 wall slides, 10 prone Y-T raises and 7 dead bugs per side.

tasks.title: 3-minute cool-down
tasks.description: Stretch calves, quads, chest and upper back gently.

tasks.title: 10-minute mobility reset
tasks.description: Repeat your favourite mobility moves from Tuesday.

tasks.title: 5-minute warm-up
tasks.description: Repeat Monday’s warm-up.

tasks.title: 3 rounds: squat, push, hinge, core
tasks.description: Do 8 chair squats, 7 incline press-ups, 10 glute bridges and a 20-second forearm plank.

tasks.title: 3-minute cool-down
tasks.description: Easy breathing plus gentle chest, hip flexor and hamstring stretches.

tasks.title: Optional 10-minute practice
tasks.description: Do 2 rounds of 8 glute bridges, 6 dead bugs per side and 15-second side planks from knees per side.

tasks.title: Proper rest
tasks.description: No strength work today. Light walking or stretching is fine.

weeks.label: Week 3
weeks.title: Make it feel like training
weeks.goal: Move from learning the exercises to slightly more deliberate strength work.
weeks.notes: You can progress by adding reps, using a slower tempo, or making the angle harder. Do not change everything at once.

tasks.title: 5-minute warm-up
tasks.description: March on the spot, shoulder circles, hip circles and slow hinges.
tasks.detail: Prepare for slower, more deliberate reps.

tasks.title: 3 rounds: controlled strength
tasks.description: Do 10 chair squats, 8 incline press-ups, 12 glute bridges and a 25-second forearm plank.
tasks.detail: Use a 3-second lowering phase on squats and press-ups.

tasks.title: 3-minute cool-down
tasks.description: Stretch hips, chest, hamstrings and calves.

tasks.title: 12-minute mobility and balance
tasks.description: Do cat-cow, thoracic rotations, ankle rocks and 3 x 25-second single-leg stands per side.

tasks.title: 5-minute warm-up
tasks.description: March on the spot, arm swings, hip circles and gentle lunges.
tasks.detail: Make the first round easier if needed.

tasks.title: 3 rounds: legs, shoulders, back, core
tasks.description: Do 8 reverse lunges per side, 10 wall slides, 12 prone Y-T raises and 8 dead bugs per side.
tasks.detail: Slow down the dead bugs: control matters.

tasks.title: 3-minute cool-down
tasks.description: Stretch calves, quads, chest and upper back gently.

tasks.title: 10-minute mobility reset
tasks.description: Repeat the hips, back and shoulders sequence.

tasks.title: 5-minute warm-up
tasks.description: March on the spot, shoulder circles, hip circles and slow hinges.

tasks.title: 3 rounds: mixed strength
tasks.description: Do 8 sit-to-stands without using hands, 8 incline press-ups, 8 bird dogs per side and 20-second side planks from knees per side.
tasks.detail: This session adds anti-rotation core work.

tasks.title: 3-minute cool-down
tasks.description: Easy breathing plus gentle stretches for anything that worked hard.

tasks.title: Optional 10-minute posture/core practice
tasks.description: Do 2 rounds of 10 prone Y-T raises, 8 dead bugs per side and 20-second side planks from knees per side.

tasks.title: Proper rest
tasks.description: No strength work today. Take notes on what feels easier than Week 1.

weeks.label: Week 4
weeks.title: Consolidate and choose the next step
weeks.goal: Keep the routine manageable while testing which exercises are ready for a slightly harder variation.
weeks.notes: This is not a punishment week. It is a confidence week. Finish wanting to continue.

tasks.title: 5-minute warm-up
tasks.description: March on the spot, shoulder circles, hip circles and slow hinges.

tasks.title: 3 rounds: controlled strength
tasks.description: Do 10–12 chair squats, 8–10 incline press-ups, 12 glute bridges and a 30-second forearm plank.
tasks.detail: Choose the lower number if form fades.

tasks.title: 3-minute cool-down
tasks.description: Stretch hips, chest, hamstrings and calves.

tasks.title: 12-minute mobility and balance
tasks.description: Do cat-cow, thoracic rotations, ankle rocks and 3 x 30-second single-leg stands per side.
tasks.detail: This is quiet but valuable work.

tasks.title: 5-minute warm-up
tasks.description: March on the spot, arm swings, hip circles and gentle lunges.

tasks.title: 3 rounds: legs, shoulders, back, core
tasks.description: Do 8–10 reverse lunges per side, 10 wall slides, 12 prone Y-T raises and 8–10 dead bugs per side.
tasks.detail: Only increase reps if everything feels solid.

tasks.title: 3-minute cool-down
tasks.description: Stretch calves, quads, chest and upper back gently.

tasks.title: 10-minute mobility reset
tasks.description: Repeat whichever mobility sequence has helped most this month.
tasks.detail: You are building a reusable routine.

tasks.title: 5-minute warm-up
tasks.description: March on the spot, shoulder circles, hip circles and slow hinges.
tasks.detail: No rushing into the final session.

tasks.title: 3 rounds: pick one progression
tasks.description: Do 10 sit-to-stands, 8 incline press-ups, 10 bird dogs per side and 25-second side planks from knees per side.
tasks.detail: Optional progression: lower the press-up incline slightly, or add 2 reps. Not both.

tasks.title: 2-minute review
tasks.description: Write down the easiest exercise, the hardest exercise and one thing to continue next month.
tasks.detail: This turns the plan into useful feedback.

tasks.title: Optional 10-minute favourite moves
tasks.description: Pick three exercises from the plan and do two easy rounds.

tasks.title: Finish the plan
tasks.description: Rest today and decide whether to repeat the plan, make it harder, or add light equipment.
tasks.detail: A resistance band would be the first useful purchase if you want more pulling work.
